reason: At $24.99 launch price it is close enough to Toplux, and the named lab report plus the money-back guarantee lowers the risk of trying one box. I would not pay $29.99 full price, and I would not buy a second box unless it was on sale.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19), and those last longer. I am paying extra for the sachets and the lab report.
would_change_my_mind: A regular price at or under $24.99, or a coupon or flash sale that brings a box to about $20.
